anchor: v4::Mira Joshi. The main zipper on my day pack from ORD-20749 stopped closing after two hikes. What can you do?

result.text: I'm sorry the zipper failed after only two hikes. Under our warranty, gear is covered for one year against manufacturing defects, including a failed zipper. I've passed your claim to a human agent (ticket ESC-4110), who should respond within 1 business day. Please keep the pack and take a few photos of the zipper in case they're needed.

results.title: Warranty
results.body: All gear has a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects (for example a failed zipper, a delaminating sole or a device that will not power on). Warranty claims are reviewed by a human agent: escalate with category "warranty" and ask the customer to keep the item and any photos.

results.title: Returns
results.body: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened electronics have a shorter window (see "Opened electronics"). Final-sale items cannot be returned. Always confirm eligibility for the specific order before starting a return.

results.title: Final sale
results.body: Items marked final sale (clearance) cannot be returned or exchanged. They are still covered by the warranty against manufacturing defects.

input.summary: Mira Joshi (C-1031) reports the main zipper on her 22L hiking day pack (ORD-20749, delivered 2026-09-17, $85) stopped closing after two hikes. This is a possible manufacturing defect under the 1-year warranty. Customer should keep the pack and any photos of the zipper.
